title: ClickDetector
summary: Makes a part clickable: hovering shows a cursor, and MouseClick fires with the clicking Player. Parent it to any BasePart for simple click interactions.

properties.name: MaxActivationDistance
properties.description: How close (studs) a player must be to click (default 32).

events.name: MouseClick
events.description: Fires server-AND-client side when a player within range clicks. Passes the Player who clicked.

explanation.whatItIs: A 'you may click me' sign you attach to a part. Roblox handles distance checks, cursor display, and firing with the right Player.
explanation.whyItExists: Click-to-interact is the simplest possible interaction; ClickDetector ships it whole.
whenToUse: Shops (click a stall to open a menu)
Anything 'click the thing in the world'
whenNotToUse: Console/mobile-first designs where proximity + button feels better — consider ProximityPrompt
When you need hold-duration or custom prompts — ProximityPrompt again
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
Part + ClickDetector
   player walks within MaxActivationDistance
   → cursor appears
   → click
   → MouseClick(playerWhoClicked)
```
tips: MouseClick fires on the server too — do authoritative work in a Script
Debounce per-player if clicks can spam expensive actions
Combine with BillboardGui for labels above the clickable
commonMistakes: Parenting the ClickDetector to a Model — it must be on a BasePart
Handling clicks only in a LocalScript — exploiters can fire those themselves; server handler required for consequences
Expecting clicks from across the map — MaxActivationDistance limits range

examples.title: Clickable shop stall
examples.code:
-- Script inside the Part
local detector = Instance.new("ClickDetector")
detector.MaxActivationDistance = 10
detector.Parent = script.Parent

local cooldown = {}

detector.MouseClick:Connect(function(player)
    local now = os.clock()
    if cooldown[player.UserId] and now - cooldown[player.UserId] < 1 then
        return
    end
    cooldown[player.UserId] = now
    print(player.Name .. " clicked the shop")
    -- open their shop GUI via RemoteEvent, give item, etc.
end)
